text: Implemented one runtime-rank hierarchy/open model across SyncZarr and BrowserZarr, with explicit Prefer/Require/Ignore consolidation policy, v3 inline consolidated indexes, bounded v2 .zmetadata indexes, explicit-path fallback without listing, and read-only v2 lowering into the existing ArrayDescriptor. V2 coverage includes common fixed-width bool/numeric dtypes, C/F order via transpose, endian bytes, dot/slash keys, attributes/dimension names, gzip and optional-provider codec metadata, implicit groups, and typed refusal for unsupported filters/types/compressors. Added adversarial resource/conflict/malformed-policy tests and documented the v3 consolidation extension boundary. Evidence: zarrJVM/test 103/103; zarrJS/test 105/105; compileAll green; Zarr-Python 3.2.1 differential passed v2 C, F, gzip, consolidated nested hierarchy, v3 inline hierarchy, and all prior scalar/transpose/sharding gates. Python warns v3 consolidation remains experimental, so the API keeps it optional. No v2 writer or listing capability added.
